'''Tech Mo'r''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Bith]] [[musician]] who played an [[Ommni box]] as a regular member of the band [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Mo'r and the other members of the band played at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited trying to find a [[pilot]] to take them to the planet [[Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH" />

{{Char-stub}}
